site.title: Adrian Fonseca Coto | Product Specialist & Azure Cloud Support
site.description: Portfolio of Adrian Fonseca Coto, Product Specialist on the Software Asset Management team at WWT (Softchoice) in San José, Costa Rica. Azure-certified (AZ-104) and Linux-certified (LFCS), with six years in technical support, help desk, and cloud infrastructure.

profile.name: Adrian Fonseca Coto
profile.headline: Product Specialist, Software Asset Management · Technical Support & Cloud Infrastructure
profile.tagline: I help customers get new solutions deployed and running, and I build real cloud and Linux systems to keep learning.
about: I'm a Product Specialist on the Software Asset Management (SAM) team at WWT (Softchoice), helping customers deploy software and SaaS visibility tooling. I bring six years in technical support, help desk, and cloud infrastructure, Azure (AZ-104) and Linux (LFCS) certifications, and C1 Advanced English, with a strong focus on customer-facing communication, SLA-driven case work, and clear documentation.

I don't just collect certifications. I build real systems: a hub-spoke Azure landing zone in Bicep, a multi-node Linux reverse proxy environment with TLS and firewalling, and a hybrid Active Directory and Entra ID identity lab. Each one is documented on GitHub.

highlights.label: in technical support, help desk & cloud
cases a year with zero SLA breaches

bullets: Support customer onboarding and deployment sessions for the SAM+ Discovery tool (powered by Auvik), from solution configuration through go-live.
Support RMM and network monitoring deployments in customer environments, working through network access, device discovery, and credential setup.
Work an inbound case queue, triaging requests and resolving them within established SLAs; serve as a point of contact during customer onboarding.
Contribute to onboarding runbooks and self-service documentation, and relay customer feedback to the product team.

experience.role: Customer Success Manager, Technical Support (Microsoft Partner Operations)
bullets: Owned an inbound queue of 500+ multi-client requests a year in ServiceNow and Jira, with zero SLA breaches from triage through resolution.
Supported onboarding and configuration of Microsoft 365 and Azure environments, resolving integration and deployment issues across diverse client setups.
Used Microsoft Copilot for process optimization and information analysis in daily workflow management.
Authored and maintained the team's knowledge base and onboarding runbooks, turning individual fixes into reusable self-service documentation.
Redesigned a manual reporting workflow from 5 hours a day to 1, a 5x reduction.
Diagnosed hardware, software, and connectivity failures using structured root-cause analysis, validating fixes and documenting corrective actions.
Delivered customer-facing technical support, managing communication, expectations, and follow-up through resolution.
Maintained technical documentation covering failure modes, corrective procedures, and equipment specs.

projects.title: Azure Landing Zone Lab
projects.description: A hub-spoke Azure environment built from scratch with the Azure CLI and modular Bicep: VNet peering, least-privilege NSGs, Azure Bastion access, Key Vault with Managed Identity (no stored secrets), RBAC across scopes, Azure Monitor alerts and budgets, plus Intune device compliance.
projects.imageAlt: Terminal tree of the Bicep modules and docs in the Azure landing zone repository

projects.title: Linux Reverse Proxy Infrastructure Lab
projects.description: A multi-node Ubuntu Server environment with an Nginx reverse proxy in front of a Python backend: static networking, TLS termination with HTTP→HTTPS redirect, rate limiting, UFW firewall rules, systemd-managed services, and access logging.
projects.imageAlt: UFW firewall status on the proxy VM allowing only SSH, HTTP, and HTTPS

projects.title: Hybrid Identity & Active Directory Lab
projects.description: An enterprise-style hybrid identity setup: AD DS on Windows Server with an OU structure, users, department security groups, and password and lockout GPOs, synchronized to Microsoft Entra ID with Entra Connect.
projects.imageAlt: Microsoft Entra Connect Synchronization Service Manager showing the AD and Entra ID connectors

projects.title: Vehicle Speed Limiter Configuration Platform
projects.description: A full-stack ASP.NET MVC web app delivered to a real fleet client, replacing manual, untraceable device setup. Authorized users configure vehicle speed-limiting devices over USB, manage clients and fleets, and every change is audit-logged (who, when, old → new value). Led it end to end over 12 months, from requirements to client sign-off.
projects.imageAlt: Electronics lab bench with an instrument cluster, wiring, and a diagnostic tablet used to test the speed-limiter devices
